global_limitations: Measurements and patterns are not diagnoses or proofs of causation.
No record is never proof of no symptoms or activity.
Only current authorized account data may be read.
Charts and research depend on the connected AI client.
No automatic WHOOP setting changes or healthcare provider contact.
Android Health Connect and medical-context integrations are planned, not live.
The official WHOOP developer API does not provide Stress Monitor zone durations. Do not infer them from strain, heart rate, or HRV.

capabilities.name: WHOOP profile

limitations: Snapshot only; values may be missing.
Measurements do not establish medical diagnoses or causality.

Measurements do not establish medical diagnoses or causality.

Measurements do not establish medical diagnoses or causality.

capabilities.name: Discover capabilities
data_requirements: Signed-in WHOOP Lens account
limitations: A feature list does not imply this user has records.
Measurements do not establish medical diagnoses or causality.

capabilities.name: Explore possible cross-metric patterns
capabilities.description: Compare dated sleep, recovery and cycle metrics when available.
data_requirements: Overlapping authorized dated WHOOP measurements
limitations: Correlations do not prove a cause.
Too few aligned days can prevent meaningful comparisons.
example_prompts: What patterns might I not know to ask about?

capabilities.name: Optional in-chat charts
capabilities.description: Charts when the connected AI client supports them; text otherwise.
data_requirements: Relevant records
Client-side chart support
limitations: The MCP cannot force the host to render a chart.
A user can opt out of visuals.

capabilities.name: Healthcare self-advocacy questions
capabilities.description: Help users express their own medical questions and concerns.
data_requirements: The user's own questions and context
limitations: No diagnosis or judgment that a provider is wrong.
No unsolicited clinician contact or advice to change treatment.
example_prompts: Help me ask about an unresolved concern.

capabilities.name: Provider-ready appointment brief
capabilities.description: Prepare a user-reviewed, copyable summary for appointments.
capabilities.provides: Patient-led visit notes with distinct source labels.
data_requirements: User-provided notes; optionally connected WHOOP measurements
limitations: No automatic provider messaging.
No direct Epic, MyChart or Oracle Health integration.
example_prompts: Make an appointment brief in my own words.

capabilities.name: Explain medical research
capabilities.description: Explain evidence where the AI host can retrieve verifiable sources.
capabilities.provides: Plain-language medical context, not clinical conclusions.
data_requirements: User question
Host research access to verify citations
limitations: MCP does not browse medical literature.
Never invent studies, diagnoses or causal conclusions.
example_prompts: Explain this clinical term and cite studies you can verify.

capabilities.name: Private medical context
data_requirements: Future approved importer and MCP tools

capabilities.name: Direct hospital network integration
capabilities.description: Automatic uploads or writes into hospital portals.
data_requirements: Separate vendor-specific authorization and implementation
limitations: No direct hospital network access or writes.
Preparing a briefing does not send it.

capabilities.name: User-provided stress summary
capabilities.description: Read a Stress Trends summary the user pastes from the WHOOP app. This is not a synced Stress Monitor feed.
capabilities.provides: A labeled comparison of that user-supplied summary with authorized recovery, sleep, and strain.
data_requirements: A summary the user chooses to paste
Optional connected recovery, sleep, or cycle data kept as a separate source
limitations: Not synced WHOOP Stress Monitor data, and this tool does not store the paste.
Cannot calculate non-activity high-stress hours from strain, heart rate, or HRV.
example_prompts: Here is my WHOOP stress summary. Label it as user-provided and compare it only with my recovery and sleep.

capabilities.name: WHOOP Stress Monitor history
capabilities.description: Daily low, medium, and high physiological stress durations, including non-activity high stress.
capabilities.provides: Not available from the official WHOOP developer API.
data_requirements: An official WHOOP Stress Monitor endpoint, which the public developer API does not provide
limitations: No stress-zone timeline or high-stress duration totals are returned.
Strain, average heart rate, and HRV must not be converted into stress hours.
